newsitem.title: USA: Choices may sell assets to retailer.
newsitem.headline: Choices may sell assets to retailer.

text.p: Choices Entertainment Corp said Thursday it is in discussions concerning the possible sale of its assets to West Coast Entertainment Corp.
A letter of intent has not yet been signed, the company said, but it is expected that the proceeds of any sale would include a combination of cash and common stock of West Coast, it said.
Choices operates video specialty stores. West Coast Entertainment is a video-specialty retailer.
